run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if reversing one sub-array makes the given array sorted
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct sorted sub-array reversal detection
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that finds descending sub-array bounds and validates sorted result
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns True if array can be sorted by reversing a single contiguous sub-array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases like already sorted arrays or single-element arrays
